title: F02 variant pair: the far end survives the worst digits
text: For 1RB0LE_0LC0RA_1LE0RD_0RB---_0LF0LD_1LA0LF and its twin 1RB0LF_1LC1RC_0RA0LD_0LE1RE_0RF0LC_1RC---: rounds 100 to 1,500 were rerun with an adversary that rewrites every digit above the exact layers of the far end before every round. The defect reaches the floor of exact digits in only 11 or 12 rounds, at least 19 rounds apart and never deeper than height 2m − 27; the floor is whole again within 7 rounds, and the defect still needs 3 or 4 visits against 2<sup>m</sup>. So a death inside the floor is harmless when rare, and the open question moves to the doubler-rich part of the tape. A test, not a proof.
